tests.output_excerpt: No Mint guest or compiled Qt runtime available in this Windows-host worktree. Pure-Python module verified on Windows with Python 3.14.10; platform-neutral by design. No real Mint or compiled Qt claim made.

notes: Implemented DockFocusOrder and immutable FocusTransition: ordered focus by id, next/previous with optional wrap, first/last/clear, bounded unique item ids (MAX_ITEMS=64), atomic set_items preserving focus only when id survives, and reduced_motion forcing duration_ms=0. No geometry, QML, artwork, Qt, timers, threads, polling, network, I/O or background services. No __init__.py added; Python 3 namespace packages import cleanly. Frozen dock regression tests green. Future integration still needed: wire returned FocusTransition values into QML key handlers and the focus-highlight animation; this modular component alone does not prove a working desktop. One test reads prototype/classic/Main.qml read-only to confirm the model reproduces the approved eight-item Repeater order.
